Name: Trinket Tinker
Author: mushymato
Description:
[size=5][b]TrinketTinker - Stardew Valley Trinket Framework[/b]
[/size]This is a framework for creating trinkets that can have advanced abilities using just [url=https://github.com/Pathoschild/StardewMods/tree/stable/ContentPatcher]Content Patcher[/url].

[size=4][b]What can this framework do?[/b]
[/size][list]
[*]Animated companions with various movement patterns.
[*]A skin system (variants) for companions, and related features to set/change companion variants
[*]Dynamic event based abilities that work through the companions rather than the player.
[*]Support for custom effects from other C# mods, through the use of actions.
[*]Have the player obtain trinket effects without actually having the trinket slot unlocked, through the use of special trigger actions.
[/list]
If you are looking to make mods using this framework, refer to the [url=https://mushymato.github.io/TrinketTinker/guide/000-Trinket.html]Modder Guide[/url].

This mod is licensed under MPL-2.0, contributions are welcome.

[b][size=4]Compatibility[/size][/b]
[list]
[*] Compatible with Stardew Valley 1.6.9+ on Windows/Mac/Linux, see [code]manifest.json[/code] for the exact game and SMAPI version this mod is built against.
[*] Somewhat works on Android, with the exception of [url=https://mushymato.github.io/TrinketTinker/guide/005-Inventory.html]Inventory[/url] related features. This is unlikely to be fixed anytime soon.
[/list]
[b][size=4]Multiplayer[/size][/b]
It is [b]extremely important[/b] that every player has the same version of TrinketTinker and the same content packs as this mod makes use of net fields extensively to let others see your companions.

[size=4][b]User Configuration
[/b]
[/size]These keybinds are shared across mods using this framework, for the user to set to their liking.

[list]
[*][font=Courier New]Do Interact Key[/font]: Press this key to interact with your companion, while you are close enough. This is used for talking and putting hats on companions.
[*][font=Courier New]Open Tinker Inventory Key[/font]: Press this key to open the inventory of your equipped trinket(s).
[*][font=Courier New]Tinker Inventory Next Key[/font]: While a Tinker Inventory is open and multiple trinkets with inventory are equipped, press this to go to the next inventory.
[*][font=Courier New]Tinker Inventory Prev Key[/font]: While a Tinker Inventory is open and multiple trinkets with inventory are equipped, press this to go to the previous inventory.
[/list]

These settings are global across all trinkets created using this framework, but have no effect on other trinkets (base game, added via other C# mods).

[list]
[*][font=Courier New]Hide During Events[/font]: Hide all trinket companions during events. Only affects trinkets added via trinket tinker.
[*][font=Courier New]Draw Debug Mode[/font]: Enable a draw debug mode that highlights the bounds of the companion and show their current frame number. If you are not a mod developer and you see a magenta background around your trinkets, turn this off.
[/list]

[size=4][b]Troubleshooting[/b][/size]

If you ever end up with a trinket or a companion "stuck" on your player character, use [code]tt.unequip_trinket[/code] console command to remove all trinkets.
